cards.forms: suger på · sög på · har sugit på
cards.english: to suck at, to be bad at
cards.sentence_en: I suck at GeoGuessr.
cards.note: Slang. The neutral way is vara dålig på: Jag är dålig på GeoGuessr.

cards.sentence: Vi kan spela det i en webbläsare.
cards.sentence_en: We can play it in a web browser.
It's a laptop.

cards.sentence: Jag har redan druckit en kopp kaffe idag.
cards.sentence_en: I've already drunk a cup of coffee today.
It's in a pot.
And over here is a tripod.
cards.note: här borta = over here; där borta = over there.

cards.forms: håller i · höll i · har hållit i
cards.sentence_en: Now I'm holding the phone.
And here I have a few plugs.
cards.note: Don't mix up with the verb plugga = to study (casual).

cards.sentence: Åh, hon gillar när jag kastar pluggen så att hon kan jaga den.
cards.sentence_en: Oh, she likes it when I throw the plug so she can chase it.

cards.sentence: Åh, nähä, hon ville visst inte leka mer.
cards.sentence_en: Oh, no, apparently she didn't want to play any more.
cards.note: On its own, Visst! means 'Sure! Of course!'

cards.forms: spelar in · spelade in · har spelat in
cards.sentence: Så nu sätter jag mobilen på stativet och så kommer jag att spela in skärmen.
cards.sentence_en: So now I'm putting the phone on the tripod and then I'll record the screen.
cards.note: spela = to play; spela in = to record. en inspelning = a recording.

cards.sentence_en: This is the screen.
I've created an account.

cards.sentence: Det här är mitt konto och vi ska göra dagens utmaning.
cards.sentence_en: This is my account and we're going to do today's challenge.
Here they have a daily challenge.
It works like this.

cards.sentence: Jag kommer att hamna någonstans i världen och så måste jag gissa var jag är.
cards.sentence_en: I'll end up somewhere in the world and then I have to guess where I am.

cards.sentence: Nu ska vi försöka gissa var jag är.
cards.sentence_en: Now we'll try to guess where I am.

cards.sentence: Oj, jag är ute på en landsväg.
cards.sentence_en: Oh, I'm out on a country road.
There's a sign.

cards.english: left-hand traffic, driving on the left
cards.sentence_en: Do they drive on the left?
cards.note: Sweden drove on the left until 1967, when it switched to högertrafik on Dagen H.

cards.sentence_en: Well, that was very wrong.
cards.note: ju marks something obvious or already known. No direct English word; often 'well', 'of course', 'you know'.

cards.sentence: Kanske skulle jag kolla var solen låg för det är på andra sidan ekvatorn.
cards.sentence_en: Maybe I should have checked where the sun was, because it's on the other side of the equator.
Here's the equator.
It's the middle of the globe.

cards.forms: norr om · söder om · öster om · väster om
cards.sentence_en: Sweden is north of the equator.

cards.sentence: Oh, nu är vi i ett villaområde.
cards.sentence_en: Oh, now we're in a residential area.
cards.note: False friend: en villa is any ordinary detached house, not a luxury villa.

cards.sentence: Där har vi en skylt för cyklister och fotgängare.
cards.sentence_en: There we have a sign for cyclists and pedestrians.
I'm looking for more signs.
They speak Flemish there, you know.
cards.note: Languages are written with a small letter in Swedish: svenska, franska, flamländska.

cards.sentence_en: And now we got a tip here.

cards.sentence: Okej, bra att veta för nästa gång.
cards.sentence_en: OK, good to know for next time.

cards.sentence: Jag har faktiskt varit i både Gent och Brygge.
cards.sentence_en: I've actually been to both Ghent and Bruges.

cards.forms: känner igen · kände igen · har känt igen
cards.sentence: Det var ju dumt att jag inte kunde känna igen det då.
cards.sentence_en: It was silly that I couldn't recognise it then.
And here we have a mailbox.

cards.sentence: Annars är det bara en grusväg här.
cards.sentence_en: Otherwise it's just a gravel road here.
Quite similar to Sweden's landscape too.
cards.note: ett landskap = a landscape, but also one of Sweden's historical provinces.

cards.sentence_en: Sweden's neighbouring country here.
Don't need to hit it exactly.
cards.note: pricka rätt = to hit the mark. en prick = a dot.

cards.sentence: Men jag var 543 km ifrån den riktiga platsen.
cards.sentence_en: But I was 543 km from the actual place.
cards.note: Also 'proper, correct': Det är riktigt = That's right.

cards.sentence: Gatunamn som slutar på T I E finns i Finland.
cards.sentence_en: Street names that end in T-I-E are found in Finland.
cards.note: sluta på = to end in. Finnish tie = road.

cards.sentence_en: It was just a gut feeling.
And here was a muddy road.
French is spoken.
cards.note: The -s ending makes a passive: Här pratas svenska = Swedish is spoken here.

cards.forms: reser i tiden · reste i tiden
cards.sentence_en: We're travelling in time now.
Maybe it's different seasons.
I have no idea.
It was almost in the capital, Dakar.
What score did I get?
cards.note: Vad fick jag för …? = What kind of / how much … did I get?

cards.sentence_en: Feel free to write in the comments.
cards.note: Softens a request: Ring mig gärna! = Feel free to call me!
